summary: Preserve auth-aware doctor identity probes and project-scoped workspace cache writes across regeneration. Board sessions and board API keys use /api/cli-auth/me, agent credentials use /api/agents/me, CLI auth overrides participate in the probe, and live projectId workspace payloads populate projects_id before storage-key calculation.
reason: The generated doctor probed /api/agents/me for every credential type, producing false 401 results for valid board credentials and skipping session-cookie validation. Generated workspace cache writes also expected projects_id while the live API returns projectId, causing typed-table failures and unscoped generic keys.
validated_outcome: Full go test ./... passes; live authenticated doctor reports reachable with valid board credentials; live project workspace reads return both workspaces with zero stderr or typed-table cache warnings.
